result.instructions: Tools for Logz.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the ERROR logs from the checkout service in the last hour."; "Which alerts fired in the last 24 hours, and how severe were they?"; "Disable the alert 'High 5xx rate on API', then list the alerts that are still enabled.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Logz.io data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run logzio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run logzio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run logzio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. logzio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: logzio_whoami
tools.title: Show the connected account
tools.description: Return the name and id of the Logz.io account this token belongs to. Logz.io API: GET /v2/whoami.

tools.name: logzio_list_log_types
tools.title: List log types
tools.description: List the log types (log type names) that the account has received. Use them to narrow a log search. Logz.io API: GET /v1/account/log-types.

tools.name: logzio_list_time_based_accounts
tools.title: List log accounts
tools.description: List the time-based log accounts (main and sub accounts) with retention and name settings. Logz.io API: GET /v1/account-management/time-based-accounts.

tools.name: logzio_list_archive_settings
tools.title: List archive settings
tools.description: List the archiving settings of the account (where logs are archived and how). Logz.io API: GET /v2/archive/settings.

tools.name: logzio_search_logs
tools.title: Search logs
tools.description: Search log messages with a Lucene query inside a time range. Returns the matching hits. Use `*` as the query for all logs. Returns up to 100 hits per call; page with `from`. Logz.io API: POST /v1/search.

query.description: Lucene query, for example `level:ERROR AND service:checkout`. Use `*` for all logs.

since.description: Start of the time range: relative (`now-15m`, `now-24h`) or ISO 8601 (`2026-11-25T00:00:00Z`). Default `now-1h`.

until.description: End of the time range, same format as `since`. Default `now`.

newest_first.description: Sort by time, newest first (default true).

fields.description: Only return these fields of each log (default: all).

tools.name: logzio_list_alerts
tools.title: List alerts
tools.description: List the alert rules of the account with their enabled state, tags and search time frame. Logz.io API: GET /v2/alerts.

tools.name: logzio_get_alert
tools.title: Get an alert
tools.description: Return one alert rule by id, with its query, conditions and notification settings. Logz.io API: GET /v2/alerts/{alertId}.

tools.name: logzio_list_triggered_alerts
tools.title: List triggered alerts
tools.description: List alerts that fired, with their name, severity and event date. Filter by severity, name text or tags. Logz.io API: POST /v1/alerts/triggered-alerts.

search.description: Part of the alert name to match (case-insensitive).

tools.name: logzio_set_alert_enabled
tools.title: Enable or disable an alert
tools.description: Enable or disable one alert rule. A disabled alert sends no notifications until it is enabled again. Repeating the same call leaves the alert in the same state. Logz.io API: POST /v2/alerts/{id}/enable or /disable.

enabled.description: true enables the alert, false disables it.

tools.name: logzio_list_insights
tools.title: List insights
tools.description: List the log insights that Logz.io found for the account (new error patterns and similar). Logz.io API: POST /v1/insights/list.

start_ms.description: Start of the period, Unix time in milliseconds.

end_ms.description: End of the period, Unix time in milliseconds.

search.description: Text to match in the insight.

tools.name: logzio_list_audit_events
tools.title: List audit events
tools.description: List account audit trail events (who changed what, and when), newest first by default. Logz.io API: POST /v1/audit-trail.

event_type.description: Only this audit event type (see the event types in the response).

from_ms.description: Start of the period, Unix time in milliseconds.

to_ms.description: End of the period, Unix time in milliseconds.

tools.name: logzio_list_dashboard_folders
tools.title: List dashboard folders
tools.description: List the dashboard folders (projects) of the account. Logz.io API: GET /perses-public/api/v1/projects.

tools.name: logzio_list_dashboards
tools.title: List dashboards
tools.description: List the dashboards of the account with their folder id and name. Logz.io API: GET /perses-public/api/v1/dashboards.

tools.name: logzio_get_dashboard
tools.title: Get a dashboard
tools.description: Return one dashboard with its panels and queries. Needs the folder id and dashboard uid from logzio_list_dashboards. Logz.io API: GET /perses-public/api/v1/projects/{projectId}/dashboards/{dashboardId}.

project_id.description: The folder id (projectId) of the dashboard.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Logz.io
prompts.description: What you can do with Logz.io here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: search_logs_for_errors
prompts.title: Search logs for errors
prompts.description: Search log messages with a Lucene query inside a time range, and page through the hits. Use the log types to narrow the search.

prompts.name: review_alerts_that_fired
prompts.title: Review alerts that fired
prompts.description: List the triggered alerts by severity or name, then open the alert rule to read its query and conditions.

prompts.name: disable_a_noisy_alert_rule
prompts.title: Disable a noisy alert rule
prompts.description: Disable an alert rule so it sends no notifications, then list the alerts that stay enabled.

prompts.name: read_insights_and_the_audit_trail
prompts.title: Read insights and the audit trail
prompts.description: List the new error patterns that Logz.io found, and the audit events that show who changed what.

prompts.name: summarize_a_dashboard
prompts.title: Summarize a dashboard
prompts.description: List the dashboard folders and dashboards, then read one dashboard with its panels and queries.
